content: Sifi luluveʼwaivina vona sesebaina
Taha tuta takesi ana toʼewayavo ta wese toluveifadi itoavaʼauta Ieisu ʼinaya ena vona sabi noqolina.
ʼInega Falisi be wese luvine ana toveʼitayavo taudiega ilulumugi ivonaya, “ʼOloto baʼe toluveifadi veiaianedi ta wese maega iʼaiʼai.”
ʼInega edi lumugi weaqina Ieisu vona sesebai toi baʼe neidi vonedia,
“Maʼoda ʼeguma taha toga ʼimiega ena sifi adi yau 100 itoatoa, ta ʼaidegana naluveʼwaiva, ʼinega 99 dina nanogedi ta sifi luluveʼwaivina nasalia ana laba nalobea, waisa?
Ta tutana nalobea me ena qaiawa ʼavalanaya nahaʼui
be naʼevivi ʼabagaya. ʼInega enavo nagaba vaʼauqidi be navonedia, ‘Egu sifi luluveʼwaivina niʼa yalobea, ʼinega weaqina kana qaiawa.’

Ta yavonemi, wese ʼedewana ʼeguma tomotau 100 itoatoa ta 99 ʼidiega niʼa inuagivila, ta taʼa mona gebu. ʼInega ʼeguma tauna ana ʼaidega wese nanuagivila, ʼinega totoa mahalaya ina qaiawa gegoyo weaqina, ta ʼabiboda taudi 99 dina, mana lova inuagivila, ʼinega Yaubada matanaya niʼau ivetunutunuqa.
Mane luluveʼwaivina vona sesebaina

“ʼEdewana wese vavine taha ena mane siliba ana yau 10 ʼinaya ʼenoʼeno. Ta ʼeguma ʼaidegana naluveʼwaivia, ʼinega tolaʼai naviaqi be naloba ʼeviviei? Mana baʼe siliba nana kavona taha tomotau ana veʼia naʼewea ʼaubena ʼaidegana ana fewa weaqina. Ana ʼita lamufa nagabuya be vanue gamona naloʼilia ta nasali aqiaqiea ana laba nalobea, waisa?
Ta tutana nalobea ʼinega enavo nagaba vaʼauqidi be navonedia, ‘Egwavo, qabuda kana qaiawa, mana egu mane luluveʼwaivina niʼa yalobea!’
ʼEdewana wese Yaubada ena tovaleʼewayavo iqaiqaiawa qiduana tuta nana toluveifana taha nanuagivila.”
Taha kaiwabu natuna meʼolotona luluveʼwaivina vona sesebaina
Ta Ieisu wese vona sesebaiega vonedi vonaya, “Taha kaiwabu natunavo meʼolotodi magilafudi maega itoatoa,
ta natuna kekeʼina tamana ʼinaya vonaya, ‘Tamagu, nuanuagu baʼe ʼitaga agu vaufa una neigu eu ʼebeluvine be eu kulufayavo ʼidiega.’ ʼInega tamadi yani qabuna vewilaʼayea natunavo ʼidia.

“ʼInega ge tuta kuena ʼabibodanaya natuna kekeʼina ena kulufa vegimwaneyedi ta manedi ʼewei. ʼInega tutuvila tauya luluvaia taha diʼwe ʼinaya, ʼabo qaiawa kavokavovo nuana ʼewei ta ena mane vegumwalia.
Ta niʼau ena mane qabuna vegumwalidi ʼabo nima ʼavaʼavana toatoa. Ta tuta nana ʼinaya kulaka qiduana diʼwe nana ʼinaya ʼifoqe, ʼinega veʼale botana lutonovia.
“ʼInega ena fewa sali ʼabo diʼwe nana gamonaya kaiwabu taha lobea, ʼinega vetunea be ena baweavo naʼitamakidi.
Ta toluveʼwaiva nana nuanuana bawe adi ʼabwagega naʼai ta gamona nakoko, mana ge taha toga ana ʼabwaga daneia.
“ʼInega nuana ʼeqaʼuya ta taunega ʼinaya vonaya, ‘Vonahaqiaqi, tamagu ena tofewayavo adi ʼabwaga qiduana ge adi fata ina ʼai ʼovoi, ta yaʼa baʼidia botana qiduana vunuvunuqigu.
ʼInega ena tutuvila ena ʼevivi tamagu ʼinaya be ena voneaya, “Tamagu, niʼau luveifana qiduana yaviaqia Yaubada ʼinaya ta wese oʼa ʼiuya.
ʼInega ge daluaqiaqiegu be una ʼawanatunegu ta ʼesi una gabegu yaʼa eu tofewa ʼidewana.” ’
“Baʼe ʼidewana nuana tonovea, ʼinega yaʼitoto e tamana ʼinaya tauya. Ta luluvaiega tamana natuna ʼitea maimai. ʼInega me ena nuakolokolo vihila ʼinaya ta talafafei maega ivedoudou.
“ʼInega natuna tamana vonea vonaya, ‘Tamagu, niʼau yaluveifa Yaubada matanaya ta wese oʼa ʼiuya, ʼinega ge daluaqiaqiegu be una ʼawanatunegu.’
“Ta tamana ena tofewayavo gabedi imai vonedia, ‘Olukwayavoni be kaleko aqiaqi otaqina omiei natugu ona vekalekoi be mwali ona miei be ʼataqinaya ona veaqea. Ta wese ʼaqeyafayafa ʼaqenaya ona yoqonia.
Ta wese bulumakau kekeyavauna ta bilabilana ona vunuqi ona miei ta ʼabwaga qiduana kana viaqi, be ʼinega me eda qaiawa natugu maega kana ʼai ʼaideganaya.
Mana natugu baʼe kavonaya lova daʼaliga, ta baʼitagana mayawaina kaloba ʼeviviea.’ ʼInega me edi qaiawa itoa vaʼauta ta iʼaiʼai.
“Ta natuna ʼunutauna nawale vaoqaya fewafewa, ta tutana ʼabaga diʼwenaya ʼifoʼifoqe ʼevosi be lavua butuna noqolidi.
ʼInega taha tofewa gabei mai vetalaʼaiea voneaya, ‘Tolaʼai ʼiuna ʼinega iqaiqaiawa?’
“Ta tofewa nana voneaya, ‘Taiu baʼe ʼitaga ʼevivi mai ʼinega tamau bulumakau kekeyavauna ta bilabilana vunuqia maega aʼaiʼai ta aqaiqaiawa, mana taiu mayawaina ta aqiaqina loba ʼeviviea.’
“Ta tuta nana vona baʼe noqolia ʼinega diana vilea ta ge nuana nalugu vanuea. ʼInega tamana webui ta natuna ʼunutauna venoqi waiwai maega ina lugu vanuea.

Ta wese noga mana diana vilea, ʼinega tamana ʼinaya vonaya, ‘Tamagu, yaʼwala ʼeala ʼidia weaqiu yafewafewa be tuta qabuna eu nuanua yaʼabibodea. Ta ge taha wese yubai uda neigu be ma egwavo ada ʼai ta ada qaiawa. Gebuʼe otaqa!
Ta natuhu baʼe eu kulufa qabuna ʼeluveyaveyavuledi toyafwauta ʼidia, ʼinega tolaʼai weaqina bulumakau kekeyavauna ta bilabilana uvunuqi maega oʼaiʼai ta oqaiqaiawa?’
“Ta ʼinega kaiwabu nana natuna ʼunutauna ʼinaya vonaya, ‘Natugu una alamania, oʼa tuta qabuna diʼweguya utoatoa, ta yaʼa egu kulufa be egu bwaʼobwaʼo oʼa wese eu kulufa be eu bwaʼobwaʼo, waisa?
Ta taiu lova kavona ʼaliga ta baʼe ʼitaga mayawaina toatoa, ta wese lova luluveʼwaivina ta baʼe ʼitagana niʼa kaloba ʼeviviea. ʼInega luaqiaqieda be maega kana qaiawa.’”
